descFull: Jev-compatible API server for open decision models. Ollama for decision models: pull and serve 24 model families (Laya, pplx-decider, Clef, Winnow, Kev...) locally or self-hosted behind /v1/systemone. TypeSafe SDK works by changing one env var. CLI, daemon, desktop app, Docker, MCP server, public bench.
